nodes.label: RDSO/T-6154 (1:12 Turnout)
nodes.desc: Master Layout of 1 in 12 Turnout 60 kg (UIC) on PSC Sleepers (64 sleepers total).

nodes.label: RDSO/T-6155 (Curved Switch)
nodes.desc: 10125 mm Curved Switch with ZU-1-60/60E1A1 Thick-Web Tongue Rails on PSC Sleepers.

nodes.label: RDSO/T-6216 (SSD Assembly)
nodes.desc: Spring Setting Device (SSD) for Thick-Web Switches at Sleeper 13 (JOH).

nodes.label: RDSO/T-6280 (CMS Crossing)
nodes.desc: 1 in 12 Cast Manganese Steel (CMS) Crossing assembly with special bearing plates.

nodes.label: RDSO/T-6275 (Check Rails)
nodes.desc: Check Rail arrangement (5000 mm) with flared ends for 60 kg UIC turnout.

nodes.label: RDSO/T-9010 (Detail 'B' Forging)
nodes.desc: Detail 'B' Bent Tie Bar manufacturing and forging drawing clearing S&T Clamp Lock.

nodes.label: RDSO/T-6155 Alt 10 (Welded Joint W)
nodes.desc: Eliminated fatigue-prone Machined Joint 'M' and standardized Welded Joint 'W' for thick web tongue rails.

nodes.label: RDSO/T-6155 Alt 11 (222 mm Drop)
nodes.desc: Mandated 222 mm drop bend on Detail 'B' Bent Tie Bar to clear S&T Clamp Point Lock drive rod.

nodes.label: RDSO/T-6155 Alt 12 (Note 25/26 Dowels)
nodes.desc: Standardized epoxy retrofit protocol for sleeper dowel hole repairs at Sleepers 3 and 4.

nodes.label: RDSO/T-6155 Alt 13 (LIST-A 10% Spares)
nodes.desc: Mandated 10% inventory procurement buffer across all 24 wear and breakage components in LIST-A.

nodes.label: RDSO/T-6154 Alt 06 (Turnout Layout)
nodes.desc: Master layout harmonization matching 60 kg UIC 64-sleeper schedule with thick-web switch and CMS crossing.

nodes.label: NOTE 1: Switch Design Scope
nodes.desc: Specifies that drawing covers 10125 mm curved switch with thick web tongue rails for 1 in 12 turnout on PSC sleepers.

nodes.label: NOTE 4: Rail Lengths & Throw
nodes.desc: Mandates stock rail length 13000 mm, tongue rail length 12480 mm, and 160 mm throw of switch at toe (sleeper 3).

nodes.label: NOTE 12: Welded Joint 'W'
nodes.desc: Mandates Welded Joint 'W' for thick web tongue rails, explicitly eradicating failure-prone Machined Joint 'M'.

nodes.label: NOTE 21: Detail 'B' 222 mm Drop
nodes.desc: Mandates that Detail 'B' Bent Tie Bar must have 222 mm drop bend to clear Point Machine locking rods.

nodes.label: NOTE 25: Dowel Hole Core Repair
nodes.desc: Specifies procedure for drilling 35 mm dia x 165 mm depth core hole in concrete sleeper when inserts are missing.

nodes.label: NOTE 26: Epoxy L-100 Injection
nodes.desc: Mandates injection of Epoxy L-100 (IS:12994) for dowel bonding with mandatory 24-hour curing time before load.

nodes.label: NOTE 28: LIST-A 10% Spares Buffer
nodes.desc: Mandates 10% quantity procurement buffer across all 24 wear/breakage spare parts listed in LIST-A table.

nodes.label: NOTE 6154-1: 64 Sleeper Arrangement
nodes.desc: Layout encompasses 64 prestressed concrete turnout sleepers spaced at nominal 600 mm centers.

nodes.label: NOTE 6154-7: Site Curve Checking
nodes.desc: Mandates pre-laying versine verification over 12480 mm chord: 33 mm at C/4, 44 mm at mid-point C/2, 33 mm at 3C/4.

nodes.label: NOTE 6154-11: Fastener Quantities
nodes.desc: Specifies exact turnout fastener counts: 347 Elastic Rail Clips Mk-V and 146 Grooved Rubber Sole Plates (10 mm).

nodes.label: ZU-1-60 Thick-Web Tongue Rail
nodes.desc: Asymmetric thick-web curved tongue rail (12480 mm) providing robust flange guidance.

nodes.label: 60 kg (UIC) Stock Rail (13000 mm)
nodes.desc: Full section 60 kg UIC standard stock rail machined to receive thick-web tongue rail toe.

nodes.label: Cast Steel Slide Chair (T-9616)
nodes.desc: Elevated machined slide table supporting ZU-1-60 tongue rail across Sleepers 4 to 20.

nodes.label: Detail 'B' Bent Tie Bar (T-9010)
nodes.desc: Forged M.S. tie bar connecting tongue rail to Point Machine with 222 mm drop bend.

nodes.label: Clamp Point Lock Machine (S-3454)
nodes.desc: S&T interlocking point machine locking tongue rail directly to stock rail with SIL-4 integrity.

nodes.label: Spring Setting Device (T-6216)
nodes.desc: Helical pre-compressed spring mechanism maintaining 60 mm dynamic heel clearance at JOH (Sleeper 13).

nodes.label: 1 in 12 CMS Monoblock Crossing (T-6279)
nodes.desc: Austenitic 12-14% manganese steel monoblock body with work-hardening wear properties.

nodes.label: Check Rail Flangeway Guard (T-6275)
nodes.desc: 5000 mm machined check rail with 89 mm flared ends maintaining 44 mm flangeway gap.

nodes.label: Elastic Rail Clip Mk-V (T-5919)
nodes.desc: Heavy duty 23 mm diameter spring steel elastic rail clip delivering 1200-1500 kgf toe load.

nodes.label: 10 mm Grooved Rubber Sole Plate (T-3711)
nodes.desc: High-attenuation 10 mm grooved elastomeric pad insulating rails and damping 25t dynamic impacts.

nodes.label: PSC Turnout Sleeper (T-4219)
nodes.desc: High-strength prestressed concrete turnout sleeper with recessed canted rail seats and SGCI dowels.

nodes.label: Approach Zone (Sleepers 1-3)
nodes.desc: Lead-in track section transitioning from standard open track into switch toe.

nodes.label: Switch Zone (Sleepers 4-20)
nodes.desc: Curved switch zone equipped with 34 slide chairs and SSD at Sleeper 13.

nodes.label: Intermediate Lead Curve (Sleepers 21-42)
nodes.desc: Lead curve track zone transitioning switch radius (441.36 m) towards crossing.

nodes.label: CMS Crossing Zone (Sleepers 43-55)
nodes.desc: Crossing assembly zone housing 1:12 CMS crossing and 5000 mm check rails.

nodes.label: Exit Transition Zone (Sleepers 56-64)
nodes.desc: Exit diverging and straight track zone returning to standard track sleeper length.

nodes.label: Sleeper 03 (Toe & Point Machine)
nodes.desc: Point machine mounting station supporting switch toe and Detail 'B' bent tie bar.

nodes.label: Sleeper 13 (Junction of Head - JOH)
nodes.desc: JOH station housing Spring Setting Device (SSD) maintaining 60 mm flangeway gap.

nodes.label: Sleeper 48 (Theoretical Nose of Crossing)
nodes.desc: TNC station where turnout gauge lines intersect; maximum axle dynamic impact location.

nodes.label: Switch Throw: 160 mm at Toe
nodes.desc: Mandatory opening stroke of tongue rail at toe (Sleeper 3) ensuring unobstructed wheel flange clearance.

nodes.label: JOH Heel Flangeway Gap: 60 mm
nodes.desc: Minimum dynamic gap between tongue rail and stock rail at Junction of Head (Sleeper 13).

nodes.label: Tie Bar Drop: 222 mm
nodes.desc: Downward forged offset on Detail 'B' bent tie bar clearing S&T Clamp Lock drive rods.

nodes.label: Check Rail Flangeway: 44 mm
nodes.desc: Critical safety flangeway clearance between running rail and check rail guarding the crossing nose.

nodes.label: Fastener Toe Load: 1200-1500 kgf
nodes.desc: Clamping force exerted by ERC Mk-V spring clip preventing longitudinal rail creep and gauge widening.

nodes.label: Epoxy Core Hole: 35 mm Dia x 165 mm
nodes.desc: Precision cored hole dimensions for in-situ sleeper dowel retrofit specified in Note 25.

nodes.label: ZU-1-60 / 60E1A1 Thick-Web Steel
nodes.desc: High-tensile asymmetric pearlitic rail steel with 880 MPa UTS and deep web inertia.

nodes.label: Cast Steel Grade 230-450W (IS: 1030)
nodes.desc: Weldable cast carbon steel providing impact toughness and wear resistance for slide chairs.

nodes.label: Forged Mild Steel Grade E250 (IS: 2062)

nodes.label: Epoxy Resin L-100 (IS: 12994)
nodes.desc: Two-part structural epoxy mortar achieving >65 kN tensile pull-out strength in 24 hours.

nodes.label: Austenitic Manganese Steel (IRS: T 29)

nodes.label: IRS: T 29 (CMS Crossings Specification)
nodes.desc: Indian Railway Standard specification governing cast manganese steel crossings, radiographic tests, and metallurgy.

nodes.label: BOM Item: 146x GRSP 10mm (T-3711)

nodes.desc: Item 19 of LIST-A: electrical insulating nylon sleeve isolating track circuit signaling current.
